schema.help: Think of cycle lanes, cycle paths and their signs and markings.

options.text: There are none, or almost none
There are some, but they stop and start or are badly made
They cover part of my route
They are good on most of my route
They are very good all along my route

schema.text: How good are the cycle lanes and paths on your usual e-scooter route?

ar.#How good are the cycle lanes and paths: ما مدى جودة مسارات الدراجات وممراتها على طريقك المعتاد بالسكوتر الكهربائي؟
ar.#There are none, or almost none: لا توجد، أو تكاد لا توجد
ar.#There are some, but they stop and start: توجد بعض المسارات، لكنها تتقطع أو سيئة التنفيذ
ar.#They are very good all along my route: جيدة جدًا على امتداد طريقي كله
ar.#Think of cycle lanes, cycle paths and t: المقصود مسارات الدراجات وممراتها، وما فيها من لافتات وعلامات أرضية.

de.#How good are the cycle lanes and paths: Wie gut sind die Radspuren und Radwege auf Ihrer üblichen E-Scooter-Strecke?
de.#There are none, or almost none: Es gibt keine oder fast keine
de.#There are some, but they stop and start: Es gibt welche, aber sie hören auf oder sind schlecht gemacht
de.#They are good on most of my route: Sie sind auf dem größten Teil meiner Strecke gut
de.#They are very good all along my route: Sie sind auf meiner ganzen Strecke sehr gut
de.#They cover part of my route: Sie decken einen Teil meiner Strecke ab
de.#Think of cycle lanes, cycle paths and t: Denken Sie an Radspuren, Radwege sowie deren Schilder und Markierungen.

en.#How good are the cycle lanes and paths: How good are the cycle lanes and paths on your usual e-scooter route?
en.#There are none, or almost none: There are none, or almost none
en.#There are some, but they stop and start: There are some, but they stop and start or are badly made
en.#They are good on most of my route: They are good on most of my route
en.#They are very good all along my route: They are very good all along my route
en.#They cover part of my route: They cover part of my route
en.#Think of cycle lanes, cycle paths and t: Think of cycle lanes, cycle paths and their signs and markings.

fa.#How good are the cycle lanes and paths: مسیرها و خط‌های دوچرخه در مسیر معمول اسکوتر برقی شما چقدر خوب است؟
fa.#There are none, or almost none: وجود ندارد یا تقریباً وجود ندارد
fa.#There are some, but they stop and start: چند تایی هست، اما پیوسته نیستند یا بد ساخته شده‌اند
fa.#They are good on most of my route: در بیشتر مسیر من خوب است
fa.#They are very good all along my route: در تمام مسیر من بسیار خوب است
fa.#They cover part of my route: بخشی از مسیر من را پوشش می‌دهد
fa.#Think of cycle lanes, cycle paths and t: به خط‌ها و مسیرهای دوچرخه و علامت‌ها و خط‌کشی‌های آن‌ها فکر کنید.

fr.#How good are the cycle lanes and paths: Comment sont les pistes et les voies cyclables sur votre trajet habituel en trottinette électrique ?
fr.#There are none, or almost none: Il n'y en a pas, ou presque pas
fr.#There are some, but they stop and start: Il y en a, mais elles s'interrompent ou sont mal faites
fr.#They are good on most of my route: Elles sont bonnes sur la plus grande partie de mon trajet
fr.#They are very good all along my route: Elles sont très bonnes sur tout mon trajet
fr.#They cover part of my route: Elles couvrent une partie de mon trajet
fr.#Think of cycle lanes, cycle paths and t: Pensez aux bandes et pistes cyclables, à leurs panneaux et à leur marquage.

hu.#How good are the cycle lanes and paths: Milyenek a kerékpársávok és kerékpárutak a szokásos elektromosroller-útvonalán?
hu.#There are some, but they stop and start: Van néhány, de megszakadnak, vagy rosszul épültek
hu.#Think of cycle lanes, cycle paths and t: Gondoljon a kerékpársávokra, kerékpárutakra, valamint a hozzájuk tartozó jelzésekre és felfestésekre.

it.#How good are the cycle lanes and paths: Come sono le piste e i percorsi ciclabili sul tuo percorso abituale in monopattino?
it.#There are none, or almost none: Non ce ne sono, o quasi
it.#There are some, but they stop and start: Ce ne sono, ma si interrompono o sono fatte male
it.#They are good on most of my route: Sono buone su gran parte del mio percorso
it.#They are very good all along my route: Sono molto buone su tutto il mio percorso
it.#They cover part of my route: Coprono una parte del mio percorso
it.#Think of cycle lanes, cycle paths and t: Pensa a corsie e piste ciclabili, ai loro cartelli e alla segnaletica a terra.

tr.#How good are the cycle lanes and paths: Her zamanki elektrikli scooter güzergâhınızdaki bisiklet şeritleri ve yolları ne kadar iyi?
tr.#There are none, or almost none: Hiç yok veya neredeyse hiç yok
tr.#There are some, but they stop and start: Var ama bir başlayıp bir bitiyor veya kötü yapılmış
tr.#Think of cycle lanes, cycle paths and t: Bisiklet şeritlerini, bisiklet yollarını ve bunların işaret ve çizgilerini düşünün.
